summary.zh-CN: 把答案与文档中的每一项声明固定到可核验的来源，附行内编号引用与 Sources 列表；编号与 URL 全部来自检索，不凭记忆生成。
summary.en: Grounds every claim in answers and documents to verifiable sources with inline numbered citations and a Sources list; numbers and URLs come from retrieval, never from memory.

modifications.zh-CN: frontmatter 只保留 name 与 description，去掉 version、author、license、platforms 及 metadata.hermes 等 Hermes 专属字段。
modifications.en: Frontmatter keeps only name and description; Hermes-specific fields version, author, license, platforms, and metadata.hermes removed.

modifications.zh-CN: scripts/sources.py 与 scripts/_hermes_home.py 不随资源文件收录（构建拒绝脚本文件）；原流程中由脚本维护的 URL 到编号的账本改为由模型在上下文中用编号列表自行维护，Quick Reference 与 Procedure 各节已据此重写。
modifications.en: scripts/sources.py and scripts/_hermes_home.py are not included (build rejects script files); the URL-to-number ledger previously managed by the script is now maintained by the model in-context as a numbered list; Quick Reference and Procedure sections rewritten accordingly.

modifications.zh-CN: 移除 HERMES_HOME 路径引用、hermes skills install 安装指令及对 hermes rss-feeds/reddit-reading 等技能的 install 指引；改为「如有可用工具则使用」表述。
modifications.en: Removed HERMES_HOME path references, hermes skills install directives, and install links for related skills; replaced with 'use if available' phrasing.

modifications.zh-CN: 仓库根 LICENSE（MIT，Nous Research 版权声明）随资源文件收录，路径为 LICENSE。
modifications.en: The repository root LICENSE (MIT, Nous Research copyright notice) is included with the resource files at path LICENSE.

conditions.zh-CN: 纯文本方法；检索工具（web_search、web_extract 等）须已在会话中授权方可运行检索步骤，但技能文本本身不需要额外工具即可加载。
conditions.en: Text-only method; retrieval tools (web_search, web_extract, etc.) must be authorized in the conversation to perform retrieval steps, but the skill text itself loads without extra tools.
